entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A commoner who leads a rag-tag army with Greensleeves against evil wizards.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A druid-trained wizard who leads the crusade against wizards and uses the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: Gull's lover, who became a wizard and doubts herself.

entities.name: Rakel
entities.description: A warrior woman, wife of Garth, sent by Sabriam to assassinate Gull and Greensleeves, who instead joins them.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: Rakel's husband, a wizard who promises to stop practicing magic.

entities.name: Hammen
entities.description: Rakel and Garth's son, held hostage by Sabriam.

entities.name: Sabriam
entities.description: Speaker of the Ruling Caste in Benalia City, killed by Gull's group.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: A desert wizard who attacks Greensleeves' camp.

entities.name: Chaney
entities.description: An old druid who teaches Greensleeves magic and dies donating her life force to her.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: Armored self-appointed King of the Badlands, captured and made to wear the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Dacian the Red
entities.description: A wizard who once battled Towser over White Ridge, captured and made to wear the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A wizard who found the mana vault in the Whispering Woods.

entities.name: Stiggur
entities.description: A friend who goes with Gull to Benalia City.

entities.name: Bardo
entities.description: A friend killed in the fight in Benalia City.

entities.name: Ordando
entities.description: A commander killed in the fight in Benalia City.

entities.name: Channa
entities.description: A scout killed by demons on Phyrexia.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: A living artifact created by the Sages of Lat-Nam that stops wizards from using magic; it takes the form of a helmet.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: Creators of the Stone Brain, whose voices speak from it.

entities.name: Phyrexian Gremlins
entities.description: Creatures summoned by Haakon who snatch the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Benalia City
entities.description: City where Sabriam rules.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: Woods where the mana vault fell and the army returns.

entities.name: Badlands
entities.description: Land where Haakon is king.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The home plane of the Phyrexian Gremlins and demons.

entities.name: Dingus Egg
entities.description: Given by Chaney to Lily to breach Benalia's ward.

entities.name: Nova Pentacle
entities.description: Given by Chaney to Greensleeves to focus her mana.

events.summary: Benalish heroes ambush Rakel and Hammen and teleport them to Benalia City, where Sabriam orders her to assassinate Gull and Greensleeves and holds Hammen hostage.
events.quote: orders her to assassinate Gull and Greensleeves

events.summary: Rakel is teleported to Greensleeves' camp as Karli attacks, and agrees to join their crusade.
events.quote: The warrior woman quickly agrees to join their "crusade".

events.summary: Greensleeves is compelled to leave camp and finds Chaney, who trains her; years pass in Chaney's house.
events.quote: time in Chaney's house flows differently

events.summary: Greensleeves and Chaney discover the Mana Vault is the Stone Brain, made by the Sages of Lat-Nam.
events.quote: the fallen star Mana Vault is, in reality, the " Stone Brain "

events.summary: Rakel tries to commit suicide when Sabriam's deadline passes; Gull saves her and learns the truth.
The army wins a battle in the Badlands and captures Haakon.
The Stone Brain is tested on Haakon, who becomes Greensleeves' slave; Gull objects.
events.quote: Gull confronts Greensleeves about using the Stone Brain

events.summary: Benalish troops kidnap Rakel again; Haakon summons Phyrexian Gremlins who steal the Stone Brain.
events.quote: who snatch the artifact and return to their home plane

events.summary: Lily and Greensleeves shift away with Chaney's artifacts.
events.quote: Both are now able to successfully teleport away.

events.summary: Gull's group rescues Rakel and Hammen in Benalia City, killing Sabriam; Ordando and Bardo die.
Greensleeves summons the survivors to Phyrexia, where demons kill Channa; she dons the Stone Brain and saves her friends.
Dacian is captured and made to wear the Stone Brain; Garth arrives furious and is calmed by Rakel.
events.quote: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on the wizard.

events.summary: Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.
events.quote: while Chaney dies of old age, donating her life force to Greensleeves.

events.summary: Greensleeves frees Dacian and Haakon, who form a truce and seek Karli to stop the crusade.
events.quote: Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek out Karli

relations.note: Lovers whose bond weakened and was rekindled.
relations.quote: The bond between Gull and his lover Lily has weakened
has settled down in the countryside with Garth and their little son, Hammen
who is willing to teach the inexperienced Greensleeves everything she knows about magic

relations.note: He holds her son hostage and accuses her of treason.
relations.quote: He accuses her of high treason for deserting Benalia

relations.note: Haakon becomes a sort of slave to her.
relations.quote: he becomes a sort of slave to Greensleeves
